inner_split.algorithm_verbatim: Reuse of the registered outer-split algorithm (confirmatory_oof_rep1.assign_folds) generalized to two unequal buckets: (1) pre-sort groups by (-group_size, str(first row index)), where the row index is the position in the frozen master_X/master_Y ascending-cid order and the outer-train subset is NOT re-indexed; (2) random.Random(inner_seed).shuffle; (3) cuts = [n_outer_train/9, n_outer_train], assign each group to the first bucket whose running total still fits, else to the last bucket; bucket 0 = inner-valid, bucket 1 = inner-train.
inner_split.split_unit: Bemis-Murcko scaffold group; the empty-string scaffold (ring-free or unparseable) counts as one legitimate group
asserts_verbatim: zero eligible PTs with no positives in inner-train (registration section 6 rare-PT constraint)
inner_split.generalization_equivalence_check: 2버킷 일반화가 동결 함수의 충실한 상위집합임을 «k=5 등간 cuts 로 호출했을 때 import 한 assign_folds 와 동일 결과» 로 assert 한다(재구현이 아님을 기계 증명).
